Pentagon Prepares Iran Strike Options for Trump’s Approval

U.S. Central Command (Centcom), the Defense Department’s unified combatant command for the Middle East, has follow-up strikes ready if the White House authorizes them, The Hill reported, citing a source.
A second source told The Hill that CENTCOM has presented a number of options to Defense Secretary
Pete Hegseth
. President
Donald Trump
will keep all options open until he must make a final decision, that source said.
"We may do another little epic fury," Trump said Friday at a rally in Fort Myers, Florida.
